steps.title: A picture is a list of numbers
steps.text: The canvas draws `source.svg` at 480 × 300 canvas pixels. Every change redraws it from scratch: `drawImage` paints the picture, `getImageData` reads it back as one long list with four numbers per pixel (red, green, blue and alpha, the opacity, each from 0 to 255), a filter changes the numbers, and `putImageData` writes them back.
steps.textZh: 画布把 `source.svg` 画成 480 × 300 个画布像素。每次改动都从头重画：`drawImage` 画出图片，`getImageData` 把它读回成一个很长的列表，每个像素占四个数（红、绿、蓝和 alpha，也就是不透明度，都在 0 到 255 之间），滤镜修改这些数，再由 `putImageData` 写回去。

steps.title: Grayscale mixes the three colours
steps.titleZh: 灰度：把三种颜色混成一个值
steps.text: **Grayscale** gives red, green and blue the same value, `0.3 × red + 0.59 × green + 0.11 × blue`, because green looks brightest to the eye and blue darkest. The readouts show the pixel at (20, 20), in the pale sky.
steps.textZh: **灰度**让红、绿、蓝取同一个值：`0.3 × 红 + 0.59 × 绿 + 0.11 × 蓝`，因为人眼觉得绿色最亮、蓝色最暗。读数显示的是 (20, 20) 处、浅色天空里的那个像素。

steps.title: Threshold: only black or white
steps.text: **Threshold** takes the same grey value and turns it into pure black or pure white: above 125 becomes white. The readout counts the different colours on the whole canvas. The original picture has many more: five flat colours, plus blended pixels along the edges of its shapes.
steps.textZh: **二值化**用同一个灰度值，把像素变成纯黑或纯白：大于 125 的变白。读数统计整个画布上有几种不同的颜色。原图的颜色要多得多：五种纯色，再加上各个形状边缘上混合过渡的像素。

steps.title: Invert: 255 minus each value
steps.text: **Invert** replaces each colour value with 255 minus the value. This button clicks **Reset**, reads the pixel at (20, 20), clicks **Invert** and reads it again. In the console, before plus after is 255 for red, green and blue, and alpha stays the same: the filters never change alpha.
steps.textZh: **反色**把每个颜色值换成 255 减去它。这个按钮先点**重置**，读取 (20, 20) 处的像素，再点**反色**，重新读一次。控制台里，红、绿、蓝各自前后相加都是 255，alpha 保持不变：滤镜从不改动 alpha。

action.run: const context = document.querySelector('canvas').getContext('2d'); const read = () => [...context.getImageData(20, 20, 1, 1).data]; document.querySelector('[data-mode=none]').click(); const before = read(); document.querySelector('[data-mode=invert]').click(); const after = read(); console.log('before: ' + before.join(', ')); console.log('after: ' + after.join(', ')); console.log('red, green and blue added: ' + before.slice(0, 3).map((value, i) => value + after[i]).join(', '));

steps.actionLabel: Compare one pixel before and after Invert
steps.actionLabelZh: 比较「反色」前后的同一个像素

steps.title: Mosaic: one average colour per block
steps.titleZh: 马赛克：每块一个平均色
steps.text: **Mosaic** splits the picture into 12 × 12 blocks and fills each block with its average colour. The readout counts the colours in the block that starts at (36, 36), where the corner of the red square sits: after **Mosaic** there is exactly one. **Blur** works the same way on the 3 × 3 square around every pixel. Both write into a copy, so they always average the original pixels, never ones they have already changed.
steps.textZh: **马赛克**把图片分成 12 × 12 的方块，每块填上这一块的平均颜色。读数统计从 (36, 36) 开始的那个方块里有几种颜色，红色方块的一角就在这里：点了**马赛克**之后正好只剩一种。**模糊**也是这样，只是针对每个像素周围 3 × 3 的方格。两者都写到一份副本里，所以求平均时用的总是原始像素，而不是已经改过的像素。

steps.title: Scale, then try the lens
steps.text: This button clicks **Reset** and sets **Scale** to 0.5. The picture is drawn at half size around the centre and the corners stay empty: the pixel at (20, 20) now has alpha 0, fully transparent. Try the rest by hand. Tick **Watermark** to write `latte-web` near the bottom-right corner. Tick **Magnifier** and move the pointer over the canvas: the lens shows the original, unfiltered picture at twice the current scale. You can also focus the canvas with the Tab key and move the lens with the arrow keys.
steps.textZh: 这个按钮先点**重置**，再把**缩放**设为 0.5。图片以中心为基准缩小一半，四角空了出来：(20, 20) 处像素的 alpha 变成 0，完全透明。其余的请亲手试试：勾选**水印**，右下角附近会写上 `latte-web`；勾选**放大镜**，把指针移到画布上，镜片会以当前比例的两倍显示未经滤镜处理的原图。也可以用 Tab 键让画布获得焦点，再用方向键移动镜片。
